title: Raffles United Holdings Pte Ltd
description: Kian Ho Singapore(“KHS”), is a wholly-owned subsidiary of Raffles United Holdings Pte Ltd (“RUH”) formerly known as Kian Ho Bearings Ltd which was founded in 1956. Kian Ho Group (“KHG”) is known as one of the largest stockists, distributors and retailers of linear motion, bearings and seals products in South East Asia and beyond.
